text.en: The sitios of Pook and Ricodo are separated from the poblacion of the Municipality of Tingloy, Province of Batangas, and the sitio of Pulang-Buli is separated from the barrio of Talahib of the same municipality, and constituted into a distinct and independent barrio of said municipality to be known as the barrio of Santo Tomas.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: April 7, 1959.
